name: 15697 · Youngwood, PA
findings: ZIP 15697 (Youngwood) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (62%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15697 (Youngwood) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
